name: Camping 101: Blacksmithing
summary: As a Blacksmith, you can learn to craft a Sharpening Wheel for use at your camp. Aedi Thriceforged in Shen'dar Village can teach you once you have shown proficiency.

sections.title: Aedi's Lesson
sections.body: A Sharpening Wheel lets warriors and rogues nearby hone their weapons at your camp. In Shen'dar Village, Aedi Thriceforged can teach you its craft once you have shown proficiency in Blacksmithing.

faq.q: Who teaches me to make a Sharpening Wheel?
faq.answer: Aedi Thriceforged in Shen'dar Village can teach you to craft a Sharpening Wheel once you have shown proficiency in Blacksmithing.

faq.q: What does a Sharpening Wheel do?
faq.answer: At your camp, a Sharpening Wheel lets nearby warriors and rogues hone their weapons.

faq.q: Where do I find Aedi Thriceforged?
faq.answer: Aedi Thriceforged is in Shen'dar Village.

angles.text: As a Blacksmith, you can learn to craft a Sharpening Wheel for use at your camp.
As a warrior nearby, you can hone your weapon at a Sharpening Wheel set up at a camp.
